transcript:
[Alice Chen]: Welcome everyone. Today we must finalize our storage layer. We decided to migrate the primary meeting memory to SQLite and use strict Pydantic schemas for data portability.
[Bob Martin]: I agree. SQLite has zero external daemon overhead and allows full offline local verification.

decisions.description: Migrate meeting memory storage layer to SQLite with Pydantic serialization.
